# Ergo Developer Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive developer documentation for the Ergo blockchain ecosystem,
> including SDKs, ErgoScript smart contracts, node APIs, integration patterns,
> ecosystem dApp architecture, and community knowledge from 8+ years of
> Telegram history and video transcripts.

## Concepts
- [Boxes and Registers](content/concepts/boxes-and-registers.md): Ergo's data model: box structure, mandatory registers R0-R3, optional registers R4-R9, type system, token mechanics, box identity, and common register conventions across the ecosystem. (~2443 tokens)
- [The Extended UTXO Model](content/concepts/eutxo-model.md): How Ergo extends Bitcoin's UTXO model with registers, guarding scripts, data inputs, and context variables — enabling expressive smart contracts without an accounts model. (~2298 tokens)
- [Sigma Protocols](content/concepts/sigma-protocols.md): Ergo's cryptographic proof system: SigmaProp, Schnorr signatures, Diffie-Hellman tuples, composable AND/OR/threshold operations, zero-knowledge proofs, ring signatures, and how they differ from account-based access control. (~2245 tokens)
- [Storage Rent](content/concepts/storage-rent.md): Ergo's on-chain garbage collection: how storage rent works, the 4-year threshold, economic rationale, implications for dApp developers, and how it ensures long-term blockchain sustainability. (~1999 tokens)

- [On-chain state tracking](content/patterns/onchain-state-tracking.md): On-chain state tracking — scanning frameworks, box tracking by token/address, state reconstruction (~2367 tokens)
- [Oracle data consumption](content/patterns/oracle-data-consumption.md): Oracle data consumption — reading price feeds and external state via Data inputs without spending (~2348 tokens)
- [Plasma / AVL tree state](content/patterns/plasma-avl-tree.md): Plasma / AVL tree state — off-chain authenticated data with on-chain proof verification, PlasmaMap pattern (~2304 tokens)
- [Proxy contracts](content/patterns/proxy-contracts.md): Proxy contracts — user-facing entry points with refund paths, deadline guards, and forwarding to protocol contracts (~2377 tokens)
- [Singleton / State NFT](content/patterns/singleton-state-nft.md): Singleton / State NFT — identity tokens for multi-stage contract state boxes, one-token-per-box invariant (~2274 tokens)
- [Token minting (EIP-4)](content/patterns/token-minting-eip4.md): Token minting (EIP-4) — NFT and fungible token issuance, metadata registers, Token ID rule (~2055 tokens)
- [Transaction building](content/patterns/transaction-building.md): Transaction building — Fleet SDK + AppKit patterns, box selection, fee handling, token ops (~2295 tokens)
